Q: How can I generate ZATCA-compliant e-invoices in Flutter/Dart? A:

📦 zatca — Flutter/Dart Package for ZATCA-Compliant E-Invoicing

Package: zatca
Pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/zatca
Latest Version: ^0.6.x (Flutter/Dart)

❓ What is this package?

The zatca package is a Flutter and Dart library designed to help developers generate Saudi Arabia ZATCA-compliant e-invoices. It supports the creation of XML invoices and QR codes according to the standards mandated by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) of Saudi Arabia.

This is especially useful for apps like POS systems, billing apps, ERP software, and invoicing solutions that must comply with local tax reporting rules.

🚀 Key Features

✔️ Generate ZATCA-compliant XML invoice documents
✔️ Create QR codes for invoices per ZATCA specs
✔️ Manage invoice data models in Dart
✔️ Support digital signing of invoices using certificates
✔️ Certificate generation (on desktop with OpenSSL)
✔️ Use pre-generated certificates (mobile/web friendly)
✔️ Easy integration into Flutter/Dart projects

🛠️ Getting Started

📥 Install

Add the dependency to your pubspec.yaml:

dependencies:
  zatca: ^0.6.4

Then run:

flutter pub get

🔐 Certificate Usage

There are two main ways to work with certificates:

1. Pre-generated certificates (recommended for mobile/web):

Use certificates and private keys generated elsewhere (backend, OpenSSL tool, etc.):

final manager = ZatcaManager.instance;
manager.initializeZacta(
  sellerName: "My Store",
  sellerTRN: "1234567890",
  supplier: supplierModel,
  privateKeyPem: myPrivateKeyPem,
  certificatePem: myCertificatePem,
);

This approach doesn’t require OpenSSL on client platforms.

2. Generate certificates using OpenSSL (desktop only):

The package has helper methods to generate a CSR and certificates — but it requires OpenSSL installed and it only works on desktop platforms (Windows / macOS / Linux).

📌 Platform & Compliance Notes

  • Mobile & Web: Use pre-generated certificates.

  • Desktop: You can generate CSRs and certificates natively (OpenSSL required).

  • Certificates and private keys are essential for signing and validating invoice authenticity.

❗ Use Cases

✅ POS Applications
✅ Billing & Invoicing Apps
✅ ERPs targeting Saudi Arabia
✅ Any Flutter/Dart project requiring ZATCA compliance

💬 Common Issues / Tips

✔ If you face certificate generation errors on mobile, switch to pre-generated certificates.
✔ Always test QR and XML output with official ZATCA validation tools.
✔ Keep your invoice models aligned with the latest ZATCA UBL standard

Q: How to build a tiktok like video upload and video feed function in a react native app? A:

Yes. You can build the UI and feed in React Native, upload videos to cloud storage and manage metadata through your backend. For realtime features like live interactions, chat or calling, MirrorFly or Getstream can be integrated instead of building those communication layers from scratch. This lets you focus on the video feed and user experience rather than infrastructure.
